'''Ginx''' were a group of relatively harmless [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibias]] found throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. They varied in size and in color, but all had two distinctive appendages on the head and 4 eyes. They lived primarily in the swamps. 

The most common species of Ginx was [[Barbed ginx]], originally native to [[Makeb]]. Other notable species included [[Swamp ginx]], native to [[Zakuul]], and little [[Venomous ginx]], that were along with Barbed ginx<ref name="bigGinx">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Ginx of an Unusual Size|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> onboard of a bio-[[research vessel]] [[Jannimak]].<ref name="small ginx" /> Some of the ginx species could be trained by a skilled handler to perform some tasks.<ref name="cartel">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref>

==Distribution==
Various ginx were found in the wild across the galaxy, including places such as:
*[[Makeb]]<ref name="blue ginx" />
*[[Zakuul]]<ref name="zakuul ginx" />
*[[Yavin 4/Legends|Fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]<ref name="yavin">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Yavin/Legends|Yavin]]}}</ref>
*[[Copero/Legends|Copero]].<ref name="copero">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref>
